Title: Classic Cheeseburger on Brioche
Servings: 4

Ingredients (component | amount unit | name | prep_style | pantry food_id):
- Burger and Assembly | 400 g | beef ground beef |  | 000011
- Burger and Assembly | 160 g | brioche |  | 000336
- Burger and Assembly | 40 g | cheddar |  | 000193
- Burger and Assembly | 30 g | lettuce |  | 000079
- Burger and Assembly | 60 g | tomatoes |  | 000093
- Burger and Assembly | 30 g | onion |  | 000111
- Burger and Assembly | 15 g | butter |  | 000384
- Burger and Assembly | 1 tsp | Garlic Powder |  | 000643
- Burger and Assembly | 1 tsp | Ground Onion |  | 000644
- Burger and Assembly | 1 tsp | table salt |  | 000292
- Burger and Assembly | 1 tsp | ground black pepper |  | 000285
- Burger Sauce | 50 g | mayonnaise |  | 000520
- Burger Sauce | 20 g | ketchup |  | 000518
- Burger Sauce | 10 g | mustard |  | 000519
- Burger Sauce | 30 g | dill pickles |  | 000538

Steps in order (component | phase | minutes | text):
1. Burger and Assembly | Prep |  | Thinly slice the onion and tomato. Wash the lettuce leaves and pat dry with paper towels.
2. Burger Sauce | Prep |  | Finely mince the dill pickles until they reach a relish-like consistency.
3. Burger and Assembly | Prep |  | Divide the ground beef into two equal portions and form into circular patties about 2cm thick. Create a small dimple in the center of each patty with your thumb to prevent bulging during cooking.
4. Burger Sauce | Prep |  | In a small mixing bowl, combine the mayonnaise, ketchup, and mustard.
5. Burger and Assembly | Prep |  | Season both sides of the patties generously with salt, ground black pepper, garlic powder, and ground onion powder. **CAUTION: Wash your hands thoroughly after handling raw beef.**
6. Burger Sauce | Prep |  | Add the minced pickles to the bowl and stir until the mixture is fully emulsified and uniform in color.
7. Burger and Assembly | Cook |  | Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Spread butter onto the cut sides of the brioche buns and toast them in the skillet until golden brown, then remove and set aside.
8. Burger Sauce | Prep |  | Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary, then set aside in the refrigerator until ready to assemble.
9. Burger and Assembly | Cook |  | In the same skillet, place the beef patties. Sear for 3-4 minutes on the first side without moving them to develop a deep crust.
10. Burger and Assembly | Cook |  | Flip the patties and immediately top each with a slice of cheddar cheese. Cover the skillet with a lid for 1-2 minutes to melt the cheese until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 71°C.
11. Burger and Assembly | Serve |  | Spread a generous layer of Burger Sauce on the bottom half of the toasted brioche buns.
12. Burger and Assembly | Serve |  | Layer the lettuce, the cheesy beef patty, sliced tomatoes, and onions. Top with the remaining bun half and serve immediately.
